thought.text: The SSO flow redirected back with a loginToken. Let me exchange it for a Matrix access token to complete the full SSO verification.

reasoning_content: The full SSO flow worked. Dex's login succeeded, and it was redirected to `http://localhost:8008/capture?loginToken=...`. `/capture` is a URL I made up myself for testing purposes (it doesn't exist — 404 is as expected), and it has the loginToken attached. Next, I'll use m.login.token to complete the Matrix login with this token.

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-validate
LT=$(grep -o 'loginToken=[a-f0-9]*' post2.html | cut -d= -f2)
echo "loginToken=$LT"
echo "=== POST /_matrix/client/v3/login m.login.token ==="
curl -sS -m 15 -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"type\":\"m.login.token\",\"token\":\"$LT\"}" -o token_resp.json -w 'HTTP:%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/login
cat token_resp.json; echo
NT=$(grep -o '"access_token":"[^"]*"' token_resp.json | cut -d'"' -f4)
echo "=== whoami with fresh token ==="
curl -sS -m 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer $NT" http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/account/whoami -w '\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n'
